version.run: curl -sX GET https://api.github.com/repos/linuxserver/docker-baseimage-selkies/releases | jq -r 'first(.[] | select(.tag_name | startswith("arch-"))) | .tag_name' | sed 's|arch-||' | sed 's|-ls.*||'
